name: dana
title: Dana
description: Chat with Dana, your personal assistant, and manage her tasks and shopping list.
author: ganam

commands.name: ask-dana
commands.title: Ask Dana
commands.subtitle: Dana
commands.description: Chat with Dana. Replies stream in live; actions that change things wait for your approval.

commands.name: chat-history
commands.title: Search Chats
commands.subtitle: Dana
commands.description: Browse, continue and delete your conversations with Dana.

commands.name: manage-tasks
commands.title: Manage Tasks
commands.subtitle: Dana
commands.description: View, complete, snooze, edit and delete your tasks.

commands.name: create-task
commands.title: Create Task
commands.subtitle: Dana
commands.description: Add a task with a due date, priority and group.

commands.name: shopping-list
commands.title: Shopping List
commands.subtitle: Dana
commands.description: See the shopping list by aisle, add items, mark them bought and clear what you bought.

commands.name: menu-bar-tasks
commands.title: Tasks in Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Dana
commands.description: Shows how many tasks are due and lets you complete them from the menu bar.

tools.name: ask-dana
tools.title: Ask Dana
tools.description: Send a request to Dana, the user's personal assistant. Dana can read and control the user's smart home (Home Assistant), calendar, WhatsApp, phone calls, phone notifications, memories and notes. Use it for anything about the user's home, schedule, contacts, messages or personal data that the other tools here don't cover.

tools.name: respond-to-dana
tools.title: Respond to Dana
tools.description: Answer Dana after ask-dana reports she is waiting: approve or deny the action she asked permission for, pick one of the options she offered, or let her continue after a pause.

tools.name: get-tasks
tools.title: Get Tasks
tools.description: List the user's tasks (to-dos and reminders) with their id, due date, priority, group and status.

tools.name: create-task
tools.title: Create Task
tools.description: Create a new task (to-do or reminder) for the user.

tools.name: update-task
tools.title: Update Task
tools.description: Change an existing task: mark it done or open, rename it, or change its due date, priority or description.

tools.name: get-shopping-list
tools.title: Get Shopping List
tools.description: List the items on the user's shopping list with their quantity, note and supermarket aisle.

tools.name: add-shopping-items
tools.title: Add Shopping Items
tools.description: Add one or more items to the user's shopping list, each with its own quantity and note.

ai.instructions: Dana is the user's self-hosted personal assistant. Prefer the dedicated task and shopping tools for tasks and the shopping list; fetch tasks with get-tasks before updating one so you have its id. Use ask-dana for everything else Dana knows about (smart home, calendar, WhatsApp, calls, notifications, memories) and pass the user's request in their own words. Due dates are local times in the form YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm. Dana may answer in Hebrew; keep her wording when quoting her.

evals.input: @dana remind me to renew the car insurance next Monday at 9am
@dana add milk and eggs to the shopping list
@dana is the living room light on?

ask-dana.reply: Yes, the living room light is on at 60%.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: The server's API_TOKEN, sent as a Bearer token. Leave empty if the server has no token.

preferences.name: defaultModel
preferences.title: Default Model
preferences.description: Model profile for new chats. You can switch per chat from the dropdown in Ask Dana.

preferences.name: showReasoning
preferences.title: Chat
preferences.label: Show Dana's reasoning and tool steps
preferences.description: Show the model's thinking and each tool Dana runs above her reply.
